svg.text: Every student: own bed, compact study table + chair, Twill wardrobe, bedside socket. Twin rooms: A and B; roommates may share the Tinker. Feet and inches.
Blue = Wakefit furniture. Students per room: ROOM-1 2, ROOM-2 2, ROOM-3 2, ROOM-4 1 = 7 on this floor. Twin rooms use Centaur singles, single rooms the Orion queen.
Yellow = door swing; every door opens inwards. Light blue on walls = windows.
Red = RCC columns from the structural drawing (Agharkar, rev R1, 02.11.2026), 9" wide on this floor; they stand out of the 6" walls.
Walls, doors and windows from the architect's AFTER O.C. drawing. Furniture positions are proposals.
Orange = new brick wall; red dashed = brick wall removed. Changed from the architect's drawing, family-approved 03.11.2026:
ROOM-3/ROOM-2 wall moved 3'-3 3/8" towards the road; ROOM-2 and ROOM-3 doors moved (docs/floor1-changes.md).
